GPT-6.2 Astra is incredible for 3D:

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Greg Brockman megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Meng To (@MengTo); megjelent: 2026-11-24T07:12:11+00:00; link: https://x.com/MengTo/status/2125125308991090749; média: videó, 59 másodperc]
After working for 5 days with Astra 6.2, I've come to love this model the most. It's extremely fast and has the best taste in 3D.

Here's a landing page I built with it: https://threeui.com/saltmere

I started making more skills as a result of this requiring more steering, which is not a bad thing.

Skills I used, all open-sourced:

Particle dissolve https://github.com/MengTo/Skills/tree/main/agent-skills/3d/hover-particle-dissolve
3D objects https://github.com/MengTo/Skills/tree/main/agent-skills/3d/3d-feature-objects
Topography https://github.com/MengTo/Skills/tree/main/agent-skills/3d/interactive-topography
Border flashlight https://github.com/MengTo/Skills/tree/main/agent-skills/web-design/gradient-border-flashlight
